human_surface.fallback: Copy full frozen Patent payload when web retrieval is unavailable.

roles.seed: canonicalized request created from selected Capture intent
roles.patent: immutable scoped transport snapshot for a fresh execution agent
roles.reincarnation: reconstruction of durable Prometeo authority independent of the Patent
roles.receipt: evidence of execution/transition, never replaced by Patent status

affected_page_shape.rule: Writable target is starting evidence only; fresh agent re-resolves current Catalog before writing.

memory_snapshot_shape.rule: Only context covered by the explicit Patent export receipt may be included.

privacy_export_receipt.purpose: Make the Human Prepare Patent action an auditable, source-scoped privacy transition rather than treating possession of an opaque URL as declassification.
privacy_export_receipt.trust_rule: Receipt hash must be anchored in the trusted private Capture transport ledger and bridged to standard Prometeo evidence when the Work Item is returned/metabolized.

token_and_access.read_token: minimum 256-bit random opaque token, stored server-side only as digest
token_and_access.default_expiry: 7 days maximum; P4 may shorten after testing
token_and_access.completion_revocation: recommended after terminal Work Item state when fallback access is no longer needed
token_and_access.warning: Noindex/no-store and entropy reduce discovery/caching; they do not substitute for privacy/export authorization.

immutability.old_patent_after_edit: remains unchanged; edited revision becomes future pending intent
immutability.snapshot_hash: canonical SHA-256 over normalized snapshot without plaintext read token

drift.on_conflict: reconcile/replan or block; never patch stale expected bytes blindly

receipt_return.authority_rule: Transport status is a cache/view. Standard durable receipt/Current authority wins on disagreement.

replace_or_extend: Hard-coded agent instructions become a durable protocol path/version/digest.
Add Seed and Work Item identities.
Add creation Current/Catalog/source identities and drift revalidation.
